chapter: Looking back: rock, blues, childhood and guitar innovators
title: Barney Kessel's wit: two stories
summary: Collins tells Kessel's London bass player quip and his remark that Segovia is the king of one-nighters.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Barney Kessel. He was a stylist and vigorous player with a wealth of ideas, and there was so much humor in his playing even. You know, he's -- I've got to tell you this story that Barney told me about the -- I'll give you an insight into his wit. He was doing a concert in London, and he was going to pick up a group there and he was -- didn't have a bass player and so he asked around. They said, oh, we're going to get you the greatest bass player in London, so they got him this bass player and went on the job this night and without a rehearsal but Barney was just going to play the usual things until they could get together and do a little rehearsing, and they played the first set and this bass player had this technique. He's running all over the bass, and he's playing his -- as fast as lightening you know. And Barnie's trying to solo it and this guy's playing his -- as fast as Barnie.

So when they finished the set the bass player came over and put his arms around Barney and said, oh, I sure enjoyed playing with you, Barney, and well, what do you think of -- how's it going to be. Barney said, well you really want to know what I think. He said, yes. He said, I think you and I both need a bass player. That's Barney, you know. That's pretty good.
He also -- another story. We were discussing about the guitar, how it -- physically it doesn't draw upon an individual as a trumpet. It doesn't require the physical

stamina, you know. A trumpet player or say a drummer or trombone player, you know. And we -- and I said, yes, you're right, Barney, I said because look at Segovia. I said Segovia is still -- he's a tremendous artist and he's still travelling, he's doing concerts. And Barney said, yes, John, he's the king of one nighters. That'll give you -- and that shows in his playing, you know. I mean the humor and the camaraderie, and he's just -- he's a pleasure. And he is a stylist.
